# i18n / Translations (DMP Catalogue plugin)

## Key facts

- Translation source files: `dmpcatalogue/i18n/dmpcatalogue_<lang>.ts` (XML, edit these).
- Compiled files: `dmpcatalogue/i18n/dmpcatalogue_<lang>.qm` (binary, loaded at runtime).
  - `.qm` files are **gitignored** (see `.gitignore`) and are NOT committed for local dev —
    they're generated by CI (`.github/workflows/package.yaml` runs `lrelease dmpcatalogue/i18n/*.ts`).
  - To see a translation change in a local/running QGIS, you must recompile the `.qm`
    yourself, then restart QGIS (or reload the plugin) — the `.qm` is only loaded once,
    in `DmpPlugin.__init__()` in [plugin.py](../../../dmpcatalogue/plugin.py).
- Supported locales: `LOCALES = ["dk", "en"]`, `DEFAULT_LOCALE = "dk"` in
  [dmpcatalogue/constants.py](../../../dmpcatalogue/constants.py). Full list of `.ts`/`.qm`
  language files also includes `da`, `de`, `fr`, `uk`, `vn` (see `dmpcatalogue/plugin.pro`
  `TRANSLATIONS` variable).
- Runtime loading logic (`plugin.py`): reads `QgsApplication.locale()`, looks for
  `i18n/dmpcatalogue_<locale>.qm`; if the full locale (e.g. `da_DK`) has no file, falls
  back to the short code (e.g. `da`).

## lrelease tool path (this machine)

`lrelease` (Qt Linguist tool used to compile `.ts` → `.qm`) is not on `PATH` and not
bundled with the local OSGeo4W/QGIS install. It was found at:

```
C:\Qt\6.11.1\mingw_64\bin\lrelease.exe
```

## Procedure: edit a translation and see it in QGIS

1. Edit the `<translation>` text in the relevant `dmpcatalogue/i18n/dmpcatalogue_<lang>.ts` file.
2. Compile it to `.qm`:
   ```powershell
   & "C:\Qt\6.11.1\mingw_64\bin\lrelease.exe" dmpcatalogue\i18n\dmpcatalogue_da.ts
   ```
   (or `lrelease dmpcatalogue/i18n/*.ts` to compile all languages at once)
3. Restart QGIS (or disable/re-enable the plugin) to reload the `.qm`.

## Procedure: add a new translatable string

1. Wrap new UI text in `self.tr(...)` (Python) or set it as the `<string>` in the `.ui` file.
2. Regenerate `.ts` files with `pylupdate5 dmpcatalogue/ -ts dmpcatalogue/i18n/dmpcatalogue_da.ts`
   (repeat per language, or list all `.ts` files at once).
3. Fill in `<translation>` for the new `<source>` entries.
4. Compile with `lrelease` as above.

See also [development.md](../../../development.md) for the full contributor-facing writeup.
